products.name: EMA Ribbon (4-Layer)
products.description: Draws 4 EMAs in a gradient. When stacked in order, you're trending. The foundation of trend reading.
products.preview:
ema1 = ta.ema(close, 8)
ema2 = ta.ema(close, 26)
ema3 = ta.ema(close, 80)
ema4 = ta.ema(close, 233)

products.name: Previous Day High/Low/Close
products.description: Horizontal lines at yesterday's High, Low, and Close. Simple but powerful institutional levels.
products.preview:
[pd_h, pd_l, pd_c] = request.security("D",
    [high[1], low[1], close[1]])

products.name: Weekly Open Line
products.description: Horizontal line at weekly open. Above = bullish week bias, below = bearish. Institutional key level.
products.preview: weekly_open = request.security("W", open)

products.name: Candle Countdown Timer
products.description: Countdown to current candle close. Never get caught off guard by a candle closing.
products.preview:
remaining = tf_ms - elapsed
mins = remaining / 60000
secs = remaining / 1000 % 60

products.name: Session Highlighter
products.description: Colors chart background during London, New York, Tokyo, Sydney sessions. Know which session you're trading.
products.preview:
is_london = t >= 480 and t < 990
is_ny = t >= 810 and t < 1200
bgcolor(is_london ? london_col : na)

products.name: Weekly Analysis Template
products.description: Framework for weekly market analysis. Tracks key levels, bias, and events to watch.

products.name: Volatility Report Generator
products.description: Calculates ATR ratios and ranks pairs by volatility. Find the movers before they move.
products.preview:
atr_ratio = ta.atr(14) / ta.atr(50)
volatility_rank = atr_ratio > 1.2 ? "HIGH" : "NORMAL"

products.name: Pair-by-Pair Metrics
products.description: Daily stats per pair: range, ATR, session performance. Know your pairs.
products.preview:
daily_range = high - low
atr_14 = ta.atr(14)
london_range = london_high - london_low

products.name: Volatility Band System
products.description: 8-level ATR classifier. Colors candles by volatility intensity. Bands 6/7/8 = trigger zones. Core Recoil logic.
products.preview:
ratio = trueRange / ta.atr(8)
volBand = ratio > 3.0 ? 8 :
         ratio > 2.55 ? 7 :
         ratio > 2.10 ? 6 : 5

products.name: ATR Stop Loss Calculator
products.description: Dynamic stop loss based on ATR. Shows exact price and pip distance. From Recoil's risk engine.
products.preview:
atr_val = ta.atr(14)
sl_dist = atr_val * multiplier
sl_price = close - sl_dist

products.name: Trend Alignment Risk Scaler
products.description: Scales position size based on trend alignment. Full size with trend, half size counter-trend.
products.preview:
alignment = ema_bias == trade_direction
size_mult = alignment ? 1.0 : 0.5
adjusted_lots = base_lots * size_mult

products.name: Partial TP Manager
products.description: Logic for taking partials at TP1/TP2. Moves SL to breakeven after first partial.
products.preview:
if hit_tp1
    close_percent(50)
    move_sl_to_entry()
if hit_tp2
    close_percent(30)

products.name: TP/SL Price Calculator
products.description: Calculates exact TP and SL prices based on entry, direction, and R:R ratio.
products.preview:
risk_pips = math.abs(entry - sl) / pip
tp1_price = entry + (risk_pips * 1.5 * pip)
tp2_price = entry + (risk_pips * 3.0 * pip)

products.name: Vortex Digital Root Engine
products.description: The core Meridian cycle detection. Converts vortex oscillator to digital root for phase alignment.
products.preview:
vi_plus = ta.vwma(tr_plus, 14) / ta.atr(14)
vi_minus = ta.vwma(tr_minus, 14) / ta.atr(14)
digital_root = reduce_to_root(vi_plus - vi_minus)

products.name: AMD Phase Engine
products.description: Accumulation → Manipulation → Distribution phase detection. Know where you are in the cycle.
products.preview:
phase = volume_spike and range_tight ? "ACCUMULATION" :
        sweep_detected ? "MANIPULATION" :
        expansion ? "DISTRIBUTION" : "NEUTRAL"

products.name: Cycle Confluence Detector
products.description: Finds where multiple cycle lengths align. High confluence = high probability reversal zones.
products.preview:
c1 = cycle_phase(8)
c2 = cycle_phase(21)
c3 = cycle_phase(55)
confluence = c1 == c2 and c2 == c3

products.name: Regime Scanner
products.description: Scores trading conditions 0-90. PRIME/FAVORABLE/MARGINAL/DEGRADED. The Cockpit decision engine.
products.preview:
vs = volatility_normal ? 40 : 20
ts = math.min(adx, 50)
score = vs + ts
regime = score > 70 ? "PRIME" : ...

products.name: Fair Value Gap Detector
products.description: Finds imbalance zones. Tracks lifecycle: fresh → tapped → filled. From Cockpit's structure engine.

products.name: Liquidity Pool Detector
products.description: Swing high/low detection with sweep tracking. Where stops cluster — where institutions hunt.

products.name: Multi-TF Regime Aggregator
products.description: Pulls regime scores from 4 timeframes. Aggregate score tells you if all TFs agree.
products.preview:
[r1] = request.security(tf1, regime_score)
[r2] = request.security(tf2, regime_score)
aggregate = (r1 + r2 + r3 + r4) / 4

products.name: HTF Bias Overlay
products.description: Shows D1/W1 bias as colored bar on any timeframe. Never trade against the higher timeframe.
products.preview:
[d1_bias] = request.security("D", ema_stack_bias)
[w1_bias] = request.security("W", ema_stack_bias)
bgcolor(d1_bias == "BULL" ? bull_col : bear_col)

products.name: MT5 On-Chart Dashboard
products.description: Live P&L, trade count, daily stats, connection status. All info on your MT5 chart.
